title: The Ethics of ChatGPT in Medicine and Healthcare: A Systematic Review on Large Language Models (LLMs)

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic review of studies identifying racial bias in clinical predictions, diagnoses, and training data representation (e.g., bias towards Black patients).
Systematic review of literature highlighting the perpetuation of gender stereotypes and disparities in medical AI outputs.
Systematic review of findings regarding the lack of diverse cultural representation in training datasets and potential for cultural bias.
Evaluation of the predominance of English-language data in knowledge bases and the resulting underrepresentation of other regions.
Review of concerns regarding accessibility, affordability, and the digital divide, particularly in low-resource settings compared to well-funded healthcare systems.
